deck.label: VERO
deck.why: Letter stamp: moderare = caution wording. Spot letters → VERO. No Italian reading.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato richiede di moderare la velocità
example.en: The sign shown requires to moderate the speed.

deck.test: See moderare → VERO.

deck.label: VERO
deck.why: Letter stamp only: spot richiede and tap VERO. Do not judge whether a duty follows — non-Italian users cannot read the sentence.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato richiede di moderare la velocità
example.en: The sign shown requires to moderate the speed.

deck.test: See letters richiede → VERO. Never ask if the duty is real.

deck.label: VERO
deck.why: It describes the danger the sign exists for.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato comporta di procedere a velocità moderata e di evitare brusche manovre
example.en: The sign shown involves proceeding at moderate speed and avoiding brusche maneuvers.

deck.test: A word describing sudden danger (abrupt, violent) → VERO.

deck.label: VERO
deck.why: A sudden event is exactly what the hazard sign warns about.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato invita a fare attenzione ai bambini che possono attraversare improvvisamente la strada
example.en: The depicted signal invites to pay attention to children who can suddenly cross the road.

deck.test: Suddenly / without warning → VERO.

deck.label: VERO
deck.why: Conditional phrasing is the code's own safe wording.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato si trova su strade che, in particolari condizioni, sono innevate o ghiacciate
example.en: The sign shown is on roads that, in particular conditions, are snowed or frozen.

deck.test: if / in these conditions → VERO.

deck.label: VERO
deck.why: A hedged claim cannot be absolutely wrong.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato preannuncia un tratto di strada che potrebbe allagarsi in caso di forti piogge
example.en: The sign shown predicts a stretch of road that could flood in case of heavy rain.

deck.test: could / might / may → VERO.

deck.label: VERO
deck.why: Sign combinations are described truthfully in the bank.

example.it: Il pannello integrativo in figura può essere abbinato ad un segnale di obbligo
example.en: The supplementary panel can be combined with an obligation signal.

deck.test: The sentence joins two signs or a sign + panel → VERO.

deck.label: VERO
deck.why: Leaves room for exceptions, so the claim survives.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato preavvisa eventuali depositi temporanei di materiali o macchinari
example.en: The sign shown prevents temporary deposits of materials or machinery.

deck.test: possible / any / if there is one → VERO.

deck.label: VERO
deck.why: Chapter 4 states the straight-ahead rule correctly in both directions, so the claim always matches the picture.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato indica che è consentito proseguire diritto
example.en: The sign shown indicates that it is allowed to continue straight.

deck.test: A sentence about going straight, on a mandatory sign → VERO.

deck.label: VERO
deck.en: it gives advance warning to (turn / continue)
deck.why: Information signs that announce a direction ahead are described truthfully.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato preavvisa di svoltare a destra per S. Giovanni
example.en: The sign shown preempted to turn right for St. John.

deck.test: Sign that tells you where to turn ahead → VERO.

deck.label: VERO
deck.why: 'Some' keeps the claim small enough to be true.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato consente la sosta in alcune ore e la vieta in altre
example.en: The sign shown allows rest in some hours and bans it in other.

deck.test: some / several → VERO. Careful: «alcuni veicoli» is the one family with 6 false exceptions.

deck.label: VERO
deck.why: The obligation signs here really do force drivers to the stated side.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato obbliga i conducenti a passare a destra di un ostacolo
example.en: The sign shown obliges drivers to pass right of an obstacle.

deck.test: «drivers must pass right/left of an island» → VERO.

deck.label: VERO
deck.why: A time-and-day restriction on a panel is exactly what the panel really says.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato vieta la sosta nella fascia oraria indicata, dei giorni festivi
example.en: The sign shown prohibits stopping in the indicated time slot, holidays.

deck.test: A panel valid «on the indicated days» → VERO.

deck.label: FALSO
deck.why: Warning statements that talk about transit are the false ones.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato vieta il transito ai pedoni
example.en: The sign shown prohibits transit to pedestrians.

deck.test: «transito / passaggio» on a triangle → FALSO.

deck.label: FALSO
deck.why: Direction claims are the planted error in this chapter.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato preannuncia un senso unico
example.en: The sign shown predicts a unique sense.

deck.test: «senso unico / direction» on a blue disc → FALSO.

deck.label: FALSO
deck.why: Combo stamp: WARNING triangle + vieta = wrong family. Shape first, then letters → FALSO on triangles only.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato vieta il sorpasso dei tram
example.en: The sign shown prohibits the overtaking of trams.

deck.test: Triangle + vieta → FALSO.

deck.label: FALSO
deck.why: The bank pairs a real duty with a denial — always false.

example.it: In presenza del segnale raffigurato non è obbligatorio dare la precedenza ai pedoni che attraversano sulle strisce pedonali
example.en: In the presence of the sign shown it is not obligatory to give way to pedestrians crossing the pedonal strips.

deck.test: The sentence says something is NOT mandatory → FALSO.

deck.label: FALSO
deck.why: Invents a location restriction the code does not have.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato si trova solo su strade urbane
example.en: The sign shown is only on urban roads.

deck.test: «only in / only on / only at» + a place → FALSO.

deck.label: FALSO
deck.why: Chain sentences are planted to sound obligatory.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato consiglia di montare le catene
example.en: The sign shown recommends to mount the chains.

deck.test: Snow chains stated as an unconditional duty → FALSO.

deck.label: FALSO
deck.why: Hangs a duty on the wrong subject.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato indica che è obbligatorio svoltare a destra
example.en: The sign shown indicates that it is mandatory to turn right.

deck.test: «that it is mandatory» attached to a thing that has no such duty → FALSO.

deck.label: FALSO
deck.why: A blue obligation disc is not an information sign.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato è un segnale di indicazione
example.en: The sign shown is an indication signal.

deck.test: «information / indicates» on a blue disc → FALSO.

deck.label: FALSO
deck.why: Over-restricts a right of way the code grants generally.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato preannuncia un incrocio in cui vale la regola di dare la precedenza solo a destra
example.en: The sign shown warns of a crossroads in which the rule is worth giving precedence only to the right.

deck.test: priority + «only» → FALSO.

deck.label: FALSO
deck.why: The exam denies a consequence that really exists.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato, su autostrada, non comporta una riduzione della velocità
example.en: The sign shown on the highway does not result in a reduction in speed.

deck.test: «does not involve / does not imply» → FALSO.

deck.label: FALSO
deck.why: In these statements the 'closed' claim is the planted error.

example.it: Il segnale raffigurato indica una strada chiusa
example.en: The sign shown indicates a closed road.

deck.test: «closed» applied to a lane, road or passage → FALSO.

deck.label: FALSO
deck.why: The sentence always describes a different panel than (A), so the claim is never true.

example.it: Il pannello raffigurato (A) indica una strada in salita
example.en: The panel depicted (A) indicates an uphill road.

deck.test: «panel (A) indicates…» → FALSO.

conflict.note: Trigger beats absolute word in almost every clash.
